title: On a scope-distinct store a public key names one memory per project; no project's operation moves, discloses or depends on another's, and the canonical write gate refuses host-built proposals naming another project's memory

invariants.statement: Another project's promotion of the same public key creates that project's own memory (receipt v0 -> v1, snapshot v0) and leaves the owner's head, version, recall and history byte-identical; a host-built promotion from another project that names the owner's canonical memory is refused with target_unavailable, v0/v0, retains no episode and discloses nothing (W1h).
invariants.falsified_by: a commit, any other refusal token, a non-v0 state, or any owner-side change

invariants.statement: correct, forget, permanent forget and dispute from another project of a public key it never wrote read byte-identically (ids and timestamps folded) to the same call on an id nobody wrote, and change nothing; a host-built governed pruning from another project naming the owner's canonical memory reads fact_not_found and changes nothing (W2h).
invariants.falsified_by: any difference from the unknown-id result, a tombstone, a dispute mark or an invalidated head

invariants.statement: Across restarts, another project's writes to the same public key act only on its own memory, which it may correct and delete like any owner; the owner's head, version, history and recall never move.

An override leaving required isolation domains outside the bound domains is malformed (ValueError with one fixed message, checked first); every other override that changes the handle's project or isolation domains -- a superset naming the owner's project, or a complete re-declaration of the owner's scope -- is refused with ValueError for any target and operation, so nothing is written, deleted or disputed (facade identity binding, store-open 1.0.0).
invariants.falsified_by: a result instead of ValueError, a ValueError whose message differs by target, a commit of remember/correct under the superset override, or a documented disposition silently changing

invariants.statement: The owner's own remember, correct and dispute stay admitted (a disputed head is recorded as disputed and, as documented, withheld from the owner's own admission while staying a visible candidate), and the same text in an unrelated memory of another project is independent.
invariants.falsified_by: an owner operation refused, or either project's recall admitting the other's fact

invariants.statement: A host-built proposal from another project naming the owner's canonical memory, and one parked by policy review, persist no episode, live and after restart; a committed proposal keeps its episode.
invariants.falsified_by: an episode retrievable after a refusal or review park, or absent after a commit

invariants.statement: Another project's operations on the same public key, and its attempts on the owner's fact by uuid, leave no event, identifier or text in the owner's history; a former owner may re-create its own deleted id whatever another project does with the same public key, and its fact-level answers on the deleted generation stay already_deleted; the other project's history names only its own memory.
invariants.falsified_by: any extra event, identifier or text in the live generation's history, a non-blank view for the refused project, or a former-owner answer that differs between the control and the re-creation case

invariants.statement: Generations are counted per (project, key): another project's first write is its own generation (v0 -> v1); the owner's re-creation of its deleted id starts its own counter; a refused or policy-parked proposal on a tombstoned or new id reports v0; the owner's deleted view keeps the version its deletion recorded until it re-creates.
invariants.falsified_by: the former count in any writer's receipt, snapshot or history, a changed former-owner view, or a former-owner act admitted
